title: Optimal Explicit and Implicit Regularization Strengths in High-Dimensional Continual Linear Regression
abstract: arXiv:2610.20804v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study continual linear regression in a high-dimensional regime, where a learner observes a sequence of tasks and updates its parameters sequentially. In this setting, we derive an explicit closed-form expression for the generalization loss of a model trained with gradient descent for a fixed number of steps per task, which holds for arbitrary teachers. We prove that the optimal fixed step size decays nearly inversely with the number of tasks, specifically as $\ln T / T$, for a single teacher and, more generally, i.i.d. teachers. Under this scaling, we show that the resulting generalization loss is asymptotically equivalent to that achieved by optimally tuned L2 (isotropic) regularization. translated_title: 高维持续线性回归中的最优显式与隐式正则化强度
translated_abstract: 我们研究了高维情形下的持续线性回归，其中学习器观察一个任务序列并依次更新其参数。在这一设定下，我们推导出了每任务以固定步数进行梯度下降训练的模型的泛化损失的显式闭式表达式，该表达式对任意教师模型均成立。我们证明，对于单个教师模型以及更一般的独立同分布教师模型，最优固定步长随任务数量近似反比衰减，具体为 $\ln T / T$。在这一缩放律下，我们证明所得到的泛化损失与经过最优调节的 L2（各向同性）正则化所达到的泛化损失渐近等价。此外，我们将分析扩展到具有对角正则化矩阵的广义岭回归，得到了泛化损失的闭式刻画，并给出了最优……（成立）的充分必要条件。
tldr: 本文推导出高维持续线性回归中每任务固定步数梯度下降的泛化损失闭式表达式，证明最优固定学习率应随任务数按 $\ln T/T$ 衰减，此时泛化性能渐近等价于最优调节的 L2 正则化，并将结果推广至对角广义岭回归并给出最优正则化的充要条件。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a closed-form expression for the generalization loss of gradient-descent-trained continual linear regression, proving that the optimal fixed step size decays as ln T/T with the number of tasks—making it asymptotically equivalent to optimally tuned L2 regularization—and extends the analysis to generalized ridge regression with diagonal regularizers.
